title: Mean values of the Riemann zeta-function and its derivatives
read_scope: Read the introduction, theorem (4), and RH specialization in Corollary 1 (5)–(6).
historical_role: Discrete derivative moments
main_result: A discrete mixed derivative mean with reflected arguments is given unconditionally; the critical-line derivative moment formulation in Corollary 1 assumes RH.

title: A Note on Gaps between Zeros of the Zeta Function
venue: Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society 16(4), 421–424
read_scope: Read all four pages in print, including the main theorem, two weight choices, coefficient-independent bounds, contour sketch, and November 1983 addition. Recomputed both integral tests numerically.
source_locator: Printed pp.421–424, main theorem pp.421–422 and addition in proof p.424
historical_role: Conditional small and large normalized zeta gaps
main_result: Assuming RH, the printed theorem gives limsup normalized gap >2.337 and liminf <0.5172; the addition in proof announces limsup >2.68 and improves the method-specific 6.2 cutoff to 3.74.
correction_history: Received 5 March 1983, revised 14 June 1983. Explicit November 1983 addition in proof on p.424.

title: On the Distribution of Gaps between Zeros of the Zeta-Function
read_scope: Read the original first-page statement and checked all five authors and complete pp.43–51 scan.
source_locator: Printed p.43, theorem and empirical-gap distribution definitions
historical_role: Gap distribution beyond isolated extremes
main_result: On RH, the lower limiting distribution is positive for gap threshold α>0.77 and the upper limiting distribution is <1 for α<1.33, for gaps normalized as (γ′−γ)logγ/(2π).

title: On Negative Moments of the Riemann Zeta-Function
read_scope: Bibliographic verification only.
historical_role: Negative derivative moments and simplicity
access_note: Publisher PDF endpoint redirected to the journal landing page in this session.

title: Simple Zeros of the Riemann Zeta-Function
venue: Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society s3-76(3), 497–522
read_scope: Read the introduction, definitions of simple and distinct proportions, Theorem 1, and its correction remark.
source_locator: Printed pp.497–499, especially p.498 Theorem 1 and Remark
historical_role: Mollified moments of the zeta derivative at zeros
main_result: Assuming RH and GLH, the limits inferior of the proportions of simple and distinct zeros satisfy Cs ≥19/27 and Cd ≥5/6+1/81.
correction_history: The journal Remark explicitly restores GLH omitted in an earlier version and applies the correction to the cited companion [5]. Bui–Heath-Brown later proved the same simple-zero bound under RH by a new argument.

title: A conjecture for the sixth power moment of the Riemann zeta-function
version: author arXiv v1 (2 July 1998), with independent journal metadata
read_scope: Read all five author-version pages, both heuristic derivations, the two cited short-polynomial theorems, and final remarks. Checked how the factor 42 arises.
historical_role: Sixth zeta moment and long-polynomial extrapolation
main_result: The actual short-polynomial results hold with fixed 0<θ<1/2. Extrapolation to θ=1 and additional moment-error assumptions lead to the conjectural leading factor 42a₃/9! multiplying T(log T)⁹.
correction_history: The arXiv history lists only v1. Scope of the journal version was verified bibliographically.

title: Nonvanishing of quadratic Dirichlet L-functions at s = 1/2
version: author arXiv v2 (1 September 2000), paginated Annals text
read_scope: Read the family definition and precise nonvanishing count on pp.447–449.
historical_role: Quadratic family central nonvanishing
main_result: Unconditionally at least 7/8 of the positive odd square-free d give L(1/2,χ₈d)≠0, in the asymptotic proportion meaning of Theorem 1.

title: Random matrix theory and the derivative of the Riemann zeta function
venue: Proceedings of the Royal Society of London A 456, 2611–2627
read_scope: Read the introduction and separate CUE theorem and zeta conjecture on pp.2611–2613.
historical_role: Random-matrix model for discrete derivative moments
main_result: The CUE derivative moment averaged over eigenangles has asymptotic factor G(k+2)^2/G(2k+3) times N^{k(k+2)} for bounded k with Re k>−3/2. The zeta counterpart is conjectural and includes the arithmetic factor.

title: Low lying zeros of families of L-functions
version: Numdam original journal digitization hosted by Williams College
read_scope: Read the introductory conditions and statements of the low-lying-density theorems. Checked the global GRH convention alongside the support restrictions.
source_locator: Printed pp.55–62, especially GRH convention on p.56 and Theorems 1.1–1.5
historical_role: One-level densities of automorphic L-function families
main_result: Under the §1 GRH convention, Theorem 1.1 gives level-aspect one-level density with Fourier support inside (−2,2) for sign-split holomorphic newform families at fixed even weight and square-free levels.

title: The cubic moment of central values of automorphic L-functions
version: author arXiv v2 (1 May 2000), published Annals pagination
read_scope: Read exact cubic family, character parity, positivity input and individual subconvex consequence.
historical_role: Automorphic cubic moments and central-value positivity
main_result: For real primitive χ of odd square-free conductor q and even weight k≥12 with matching parity, cubic averaging over primitive forms of levels dividing q is ≪q^{1+ε}; positivity gives q^{1/3+ε} for an individual central value.

title: The non-vanishing of central values of automorphic L-functions and Landau-Siegel zeros
venue: Israel Journal of Mathematics 120, part A, 155–177
read_scope: Bibliographic verification only.
historical_role: Automorphic central nonvanishing and exceptional zeros
access_note: Institutional bibliographic record confirmed; original article PDF unavailable in attempted transfers.

title: High moments of the Riemann zeta-function
read_scope: Read the introduction, long-polynomial motivation, and sixth- and eighth-moment conjectural constants.
historical_role: Additive divisor conjectures and moments
main_result: Long-polynomial heuristic recovers the sixth-moment constant and proposes the eighth-moment constant, with combinatorial numerator 24024.

title: Spacing of zeros of Hecke L-functions and the class number problem
read_scope: Read the on-line zero-count convention including repeated nearest ordinates at multiple zeros, and the two gap hypotheses.
historical_role: Small gaps and effective class-number bounds
main_result: An explicitly frequent small-spacing condition on critical-line zeros gives an effective lower bound on L(1,χ). Theorems 1.1–1.2 make distinct Hecke- and zeta-gap hypotheses.

title: Rankin-Selberg L-functions in the level aspect
read_scope: Read the family setup, fixed form conditions and level-aspect subconvex bound.
historical_role: Rankin–Selberg family moments and level-aspect subconvexity
main_result: Theorem 1.1 breaks the q^{1/2} convexity level exponent by 1/80 for L(f⊗g,1/2+it) and derivatives, with specified good-prime and fixed-g conditions.

title: Rankin Triple Products and Quantum Chaos
venue: Princeton University PhD dissertation, June 2002; author revision 22 October 2008
version: author dissertation revision arXiv v3 (22 October 2008)
read_scope: Read the title and abstract, then the explicit triple-product identity and proof opening in §4.1.
historical_role: Automorphic triple periods and central Rankin values
main_result: For matched newforms of common square-free level, relates the squared normalized triple period to a completed central triple-product L-value, adjoint L-values, and local factors; the thesis describes the resulting route from subconvexity to arithmetic QUE.

title: Random matrix theory and discrete moments of the Riemann zeta function
venue: Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and General 36(12), 2907–2917
read_scope: Read the model setup, theorem hypotheses, and the opening of the zeta conjecture section.
historical_role: Shifted discrete moments near zeta zeros
main_result: Proves the shifted CUE characteristic-polynomial eigenangle moment and proposes its arithmetic analogue for zeta at an offset from zero ordinates.

title: Integral Moments of L-Functions
venue: Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society s3-91(1), 33–104
read_scope: Read the setup of the weight and moments recipes, the first conjecture, and the general recipe in §2.5.
historical_role: Full-moment conjecture including lower-order terms
main_result: The recipe based on shifted approximate functional equations produces conjectural full moment polynomials and arithmetical Euler factors for several symmetry types.
correction_history: Three public arXiv versions in 2002, 2004 and 2005. The archive describes v3 as the final version; used the published proceedings article for exact statement locators.

title: Moments of the Derivative of Characteristic Polynomials with an Application to the Riemann Zeta Function
version: author arXiv v2 (17 March 2006), PDF title matches journal
read_scope: Read the setup distinguishing the characteristic polynomial and its real normalization, and statements of Theorems 1–3 and Conjecture 1.
historical_role: Continuous derivative moment model at fixed angles
main_result: Haar unitary derivative moment asymptotics are theorems; the zeta derivative moment analogue on the critical line is conjectural.
edition_note: The arXiv landing page displays a different title. The v2 PDF title and journal title agree.

title: A hybrid Euler-Hadamard product for the Riemann zeta function
read_scope: Read the product formula, cutoff and smoothing hypotheses, and splitting conjecture.
historical_role: Explicit prime/zero factorization and moment heuristics
main_result: Unconditional hybrid product with a smoothed truncated product over zeros; the splitting of averaged moments is a separate conjecture.

title: The fourth moment of Dirichlet L-functions
read_scope: Read the exact modulus and count normalizations, power saving and the surrounding discussion.
historical_role: Fourth central moment at fixed prime conductor
main_result: For odd prime q, the mean over primitive characters of |L(1/2,χ)|⁴ is a degree-four polynomial in log q with an O(q^{−5/512+ε}) error.

title: More than 41% of the zeros of the zeta function are on the critical line
read_scope: Read the published introductory statement, setup and parameter choices. Compared the corresponding earlier and revised arXiv passages.
source_locator: Published Theorem 1.1 and §§2.1–2.2; preprints v1 and v2 §2.1
historical_role: Unconditional critical and simple-critical zeta proportions
main_result: The printed theorem gives κ≥0.4105 and κ*≥0.4058 with two-piece mollification.
correction_history: ArXiv v2 reports minor corrections and added Feng discussion. Comparison shows it adds the symmetry condition Q(x)+Q(1−x)=constant in §2.1; the final journal version retains it.

title: The Sixth Power Moment of Dirichlet L-Functions
read_scope: Read Corollary 1 and Theorem 1, checking the even primitive family, completed values, heights, and conductor smoothing.
historical_role: Proven conductor-averaged sixth moment for the specified Dirichlet family
main_result: Sixth moment asymptotic over even primitive characters and q≤Q with an integral of completed values over height.
correction_history: The arXiv record describes v2 as a significant rewriting of v1.

title: Critical zeros of Dirichlet L-functions
venue: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik 681, 175–198
version: author arXiv v1 (5 May 2011); journal issue dated 2013
read_scope: Read the family smoothing weights, height range and exact definition of simple critical zeros.
historical_role: Simple critical zeros of Dirichlet L-functions on average
main_result: Theorem 1 gives at least 14/25 simple critical zeros in the weighted primitive-character family for (log Q)^6≤T≤(log Q)^A, with fixed A≥6 and Q sufficiently large.

title: On simple zeros of the Riemann zeta-function
venue: Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society 45(5), 953–961
read_scope: Read the statement, relation to CGG, and the setup and identification of the replacement arithmetic tool.
source_locator: arXiv pp.1–2, theorem and corollary; §3 Lemma 3
historical_role: RH-conditional simple zeros without the CGG moment assumption
main_result: Under RH, at least 19/27 of zeta zeros are simple, and at least 0.84665 are distinct. Heath-Brown’s generalized Vaughan identity replaces the step that required GLH in CGG 1998.

title: Lower Bounds for Moments of ζ′(ρ)
version: revised author-hosted manuscript, journal date verified separately
read_scope: Compared the statement in the June 2007 draft, revised author manuscript and 2014 journal metadata.
historical_role: Lower bounds for positive integer derivative moments at zeros
main_result: On GRH for Dirichlet L-functions, J_k(T)≫_k(log T)^{k(k+2)} for positive integers k.
correction_history: Earlier author and arXiv draft used an RH formulation. Revised manuscript and publisher abstract explicitly assume GRH for Dirichlet L-functions.
